Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
Holmgren (knee) remains out for Saturday's road game against Houston, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re
Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.
Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.
Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.
Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
